operations.name: Pattern and Core Making
operations.setup_note: Make the pattern and cores for the SG iron casting, including the required draft and machining allowances.

operations.name: Cast SG Iron Housing
operations.setup_note: Pour the specified SG450/10 ductile iron into the prepared mold and cores; allow the casting to solidify and cool.

operations.name: Fettle and Clean Casting
operations.setup_note: Remove the casting from the mold, runners, risers, and foundry sand, then clean the internal and external surfaces before stress relief.

operations.name: Stress Relieve Casting
operations.setup_note: Load the cleaned casting for stress relief before machining; this is a stress-relief cycle, not a hardening treatment.

operations.name: Rough Machine Primary Datum
operations.setup_note: Support the casting on verified stable cast locations and rough-mill datum face DA (F37) as the first machining cut, removing at least 2 mm below the cast skin. Verify stock distribution before using this face to locate later setups.

operations.name: Rough Turn Housing
operations.setup_note: Locate the housing from rough datum face DA and support the irregular casting securely on the VTC. Rough the required OD steps and the axial threaded interface, leaving stock for later finishing.

operations.name: Rough Axial Milling and Hole Making
operations.setup_note: Locate from datum DA and the rough turning datums; rough the axial groove and face, then drill and ream the axial hole features without changing the workholding.

operations.name: Rough Radial Hole Making
operations.setup_note: Re-fixture from DA and index the casting to present the radial lug and mounting-hole faces to the VMC. The indexed fixture assumes the specified radial holes are accessible without changing the locating scheme.

operations.name: Semi-Finish Axial Bore
operations.setup_note: Re-establish the VTC setup from DA and the rough OD datums after all rough machining. Semi-finish the axial bore while retaining finishing stock.

operations.name: Semi-Finish Milled Faces and Groove
operations.setup_note: Locate from DA and the turned datums after roughing is complete. Semi-finish the specified planar and groove surfaces, leaving stock for the final passes.

operations.name: Finish Milled Faces and Groove
operations.setup_note: Locate from datum DA and the established turned datums. Finish the datum and upper planar faces and bring the groove and its walls to final size and surface finish.

operations.name: Finish Turn and Bore Housing
operations.setup_note: Locate from finished datum face DA and the established turned datums DD and DF. Finish the OD steps and axial bore/thread interface, with the Ø84 bore interpretation pending confirmation against the drawing feature mapping.

operations.name: Casting Soundness Check
operations.setup_note: Inspect the machined casting for internal soundness using the in-house ultrasonic method before coating.

operations.name: Radiographic Examination
operations.setup_note: Send the machined, uncoated casting for the specified Level 3 radiographic examination and return the inspection documentation.

operations.name: CTS3040L Structural Test
operations.setup_note: Submit the machined, uncoated housing for the drawing-required CTS3040L structural test; confirm whether testing applies to every part or a sample lot.

operations.name: Final Blast Before Primer
operations.setup_note: Shotblast the inside and outside casting surfaces immediately before priming; protect finished precision interfaces from damage.

operations.name: Apply M1006 Primer
operations.setup_note: Mask functional machined interfaces as needed, apply the specified zinc-phosphate charcoal-grey primer to the inside and outside casting surfaces, then unmask.

operations.name: Apply Anti-Rust Oil
operations.setup_note: Apply DW39 or equivalent to all machined surfaces after priming, avoiding contamination of the primer-coated surfaces.

operations.name: Final Dimensional and Quality Inspection
operations.setup_note: Inspect the completed, coated part and review material, heat-treatment, NDT, and structural-test records; measure critical features after thermal stabilization.

clarifications.question: Which drawing feature is datum DB for the positional requirements on features F68 and F70?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use the drawing-defined datum DB once identified; do not release the hole-pattern coordinates for machining until it is confirmed.

clarifications.question: Is the Ø84 +0/-0.012 callout an internal bore associated with F61, or is it the Ø84 OD reported for F59?
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat F59 as the separate Ø84 OD and machine the Ø84 precision bore at the F61 axial interface, as indicated by the assembly note.

clarifications.question: Will the mating cap be supplied for machining the specified Ø84 bore and M90x2 thread as an assembly?
clarifications.suggested_default: Machine the housing features to the drawing callouts individually and perform an assembly-match operation only if the cap is supplied.

clarifications.question: What is the required thread depth for the M14x2 holes F02 through F05?
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat them as blind tapped holes and provide thread depth greater than the valid screw engagement depth.

clarifications.question: Are the radial axes for F02-F05 and F64 accessible from one indexed VMC fixture orientation, or do they require additional setups?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use an indexed fixture that presents each specified radial face while retaining the DA locating reference.

clarifications.question: Does the CTS3040L structural test apply to every finished housing or to a representative sample from the lot?
clarifications.suggested_default: Have the supplier test the lot as required by CTS3040L and provide the corresponding certificate before release.

assumptions.text: SG450/10 is treated as a spheroidal-graphite (ductile) iron casting, so the stock form is sg_iron_casting. Casting stock dimensions and machining allowance are left null because no stock blank dimensions are supplied.

Casting stock distribution is not quantified. The datum setup and first cut assume adequate machining stock and removal of at least 2 mm below the cast skin; verify stock distribution before committing the production fixture.
The casting route's stress-relief requirement is applied before machining. No hardening treatment is specified, so machinability remains medium throughout the route.

The axial feature F61 is provisionally treated as the interface for the M90x2-6H thread and the Ø84 +0/-0.012 bore called out in the assembly note; this conflicts with the extracted F59 Ø84 OD and requires customer confirmation.
F02-F05 are treated as blind threaded holes under the general note that holes are not through unless stated THRU. Thread depth remains subject to confirmation.

An indexed VMC fixture is assumed to reach the specified radial mounting and lug holes. No pilot drilling or peck drilling is added because the available hole data does not establish a large or deep-hole requirement.

A separate semi-finish stage is included for the axial bore and milled faces/groove. The operation vocabulary has no semi-finish OD type, so turned diameters are rough-turned first and finish-turned after the other rough machining is complete.
The casting route's pressure test is omitted because no pressure-test requirement is stated; the specified CTS3040L structural test and casting soundness checks are routed separately.

Saw cutting and part-off are omitted because the blank is a casting. Center drilling is omitted because no between-centers support is needed for the housing geometry; the primary datum is established by milling.

Hardening-specific heat-treatment steps, such as quench, temper, straightening, and post-hardening grinding, are not applicable to the specified stress-relieved casting. No honing step is used; the precision bore is finish-bored in-house.
The radiographic examination and CTS3040L structural test are subcontracted because the listed in-house NDT capability does not include radiography and no structural-test equipment is listed.
